content: Russian LLM options: YandexGPT (Yandex Cloud managed, Alice model family added Feb 2026, function calling + structured extraction), GigaChat (Sber, ai-forever/gigachat lib, JSON schema emulated via function calling, no anyOf/oneOf/allOf/Union, OAuth token refresh). Both are viable RU-hosted providers when Anthropic/OpenAI are geo-blocked or data-residency-constrained. Capabilities and schema constraints differ from Western providers - abstraction layer must not assume OpenAI-style response_format.
